definitions.explanation: The final period of the calendar year, typically referring to December and the days leading up to New Year's.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: The end of the year is busy.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went shopping at the year-end sale.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧だ。
examples.english: Doing a big cleaning at year-end is a Japanese custom.

notes:
USAGE:
Often paired with ⟦{年始|ねんし}→年始：17689_nenshi⟧ (beginning of the year) in the compound ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧, which refers to the holiday period spanning late December through early January.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{年末|ねんまつ} is associated with ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧ (year-end cleaning), ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧ (year-end parties), and preparations for ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (New Year). Many businesses close during ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年末|ねんまつ}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: year-end sale
- {年末|ねんまつ}{調整|ちょうせい}: year-end adjustment (tax)
- ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧: year-end and New Year period
- {年末|ねんまつ}{商戦|しょうせん}: year-end sales competition
